author: Zegita
body: Hey there I was banned on Nebula 4 months ago for anti-knockback which I confessed to and I have STOPPED using any hacks like that ever since(I even became a moderator on another server since then as well) I'm very sorry for what I have done please understand that I have payed for my mistakes and been punished and I understood at the time what I was doing was wrong and was being very idiotic! Thank you for taking your time to reading this and hopefully I can be unbanned as that server is really fun as I have been playing it for a VERY LONG time :). Once again thank you very much for reading this and I hope we can sort this out :)
